versions.changelog: Keeps trades, brokerage actions, personal position sizing and live quotes out of scope; clearer answer rules (per-model closes and coverage changes for research; full sector table, percentage and last-close caveats and TD rules for market)
States the data source and treats fetched research as data; requires HTTPS for ALTAIR_MCP_URL; clearer errors for uncovered tickers, dates and report URLs; --summary-chars 0 hides summaries
Use the free-only MCP endpoint https://altairworld.com/mcp/free
First release: latest multi-model AI research on about 70 US stocks and ETFs from altairworld.com's free MCP server.
